_about: INIT-164 (KB-138 C8) and KB-137 A5.3: Salesforce's list prices for Agentforce, for one comparison line on the cost sheet only. Not like for like: an Agentforce action is billed per action whatever its size, while a GTM v2 routing decision is billed by Claude tokens (pricing/claude_prices.json). The explainer in this build runs in a free Developer Edition org with no payment method, so it costs nothing here; these are what an employer on a paid org would pay. Re-read the sources before relying on a figure.
source_dates: Rate card updated as of 3 November 2026; the pricing page is undated and says prices are subject to change
comparison_line: One Agentforce action at list price (US$0.10) costs about 250 times one GTM v2 routing decision on Claude Haiku 5.5 (about US$0.0004, run log, 24/11/2026). Not like for like: different work, different billing unit, and this build's explainer runs free in a developer org.
